related_questions.question: How much is parking at Green Bay airport?

text_blocks.snippet: At Austin Straubel International Airport (GRB) in Green Bay, parking costs vary by lot. The first 30 minutes are free in all lots. The Short-Term lot is $3 for the first hour, then $1 for each additional half hour, with a daily maximum of $9, according to the airport. The Long-Term lot has a daily maximum of $8, according to an airport parking guide. Weekly rates are also available in both lots.
